commits.content:
version: '3.8'

services:
  # --------------------------------------------------
  # Database 1 cho Auth Service (auth-ms)
  # --------------------------------------------------
  auth-db:
    image: mysql:8.0
    container_name: auth_mysql_db
    restart: always
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: rootpassword
      MYSQL_DATABASE: auth_db
    ports:
      - '3306:3306'
    volumes:
      - auth_db_data:/var/lib/mysql

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # Database 2 cho Crypto Core Service (BE-ms)
  # --------------------------------------------------
  crypto-db:
    image: mysql:8.0
    container_name: crypto_mysql_db
    restart: always
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: rootpassword
      MYSQL_DATABASE: crypto_db
    ports:
      - '3307:3306' # Mở cổng 3307 bên ngoài máy host để tránh trùng với cổng 3306
    volumes:
      - crypto_db_data:/var/lib/mysql

  

volumes:
  auth_db_data:
  crypto_db_data:
